name: voice-to
description: task` ← Novu (W:0.97) 的语音转任务概念抽象
interaction: Users press and hold a microphone button to speak a task description in natural language. The voice input is instantly transcribed and parsed into a structured task card with title, priority, and assignee. A subtle waveform animation provides real-time audio feedback, and the task card animates into the pipeline once released.
